_comment: Raw kB. A route's number covers the chunk plus everything it statically imports. Lower a number when you shrink a route; never raise one. Enforced by scripts/check-bundle-size.mjs in the unit-tests job. Tightened 2026-09-03 twice: first after splitting v4PanelC.ts into v4Meta.ts (light) + v4PanelC.ts (heavy), then after the heavy map became one lazy chunk per program under v4/data/v4PanelC/. Tightened again 2026-09-08 after v4Basis.ts got the same treatment — one chunk per program under v4/data/v4Basis/ behind useV4Basis(code), which took V4ReportPage from 1439 to 1283 kB and, more to the point, stopped it growing ~2 kB with every program scored. Route numbers are achieved-plus-~10%; achieved was index 667, LandingPage 1018, V4ReportsPage 1049, AssessorPage 990, V4InsightsPage 1030, V4ReportPage 1283 (all kB).
